mount.reason: Solid keeps Menu.Trigger's trailing focus guard mounted (inert) while closed, so opening does not insert a node next to the focused trigger (utils/popups/TriggerFocusGuards.tsx); React mounts it on open.

open (scroll selected into view).reason: React bug, not copied: after the aligned-to-fallback switch (alignItemWithTrigger with an item far down), React's Select.Popup loses the consumer's `overflow: auto` (inline style becomes `max-height; transition: none`), so the popup cannot scroll and React scrolls the whole document ~10.5k px to reach the selected item. Solid keeps the consumer's style and scrolls the popup; the selected item is visible in both (plan 7.3, 2026-10-05).
